## Verification

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and did not reset or discard pre-existing work.
- [ ] Local production build and the deployed preview were tested separately.
- [ ] Jest, pgTAP, E2E, accessibility, pixel lock, Lighthouse and motion checks passed, or every exception is documented.
- [ ] Existing approved visual references and design-lock hashes were not replaced automatically.
- [ ] CSP violations were reviewed in report-only mode before enforcement changes.
- [ ] I reviewed dependency licenses, third-party asset notices and code origin; publication is approved by a human owner.
- [ ] Privacy claims match the verified data inventory; no inactive recipient or unsupported retention promise was added.
- [ ] Accessibility has zero serious/critical automated exceptions; manual keyboard/screen-reader evidence is attached when this is a release PR.
- [ ] Full-history Gitleaks and project-specific scans passed on the rewritten clone, and any exposed credential was revoked before replacement.
- [ ] No generated test artifact or secret is included in the diff.
